Isikhala %1$d · %2$s. Thepha ukuze usebenzise; lungisa umbala, bese uthepha Shintsha ukuze ulondoloze izinguquko.
Isikhala esingenalutho %1$d. Thepha ukuze ukhethe lapho uzolondoloza khona umbala wamanje.
Ilondoloza ikhasi elilodwa le-RGB. Ukucindezela kunganciphisa usayizi wefayela ngaphandle kokushintsha amaphikseli; kucishe ukuze uthole i-TIFF engacindezelwe.
Ilondoloza i-Windows DIB yamabhithi angu-24 engacindezelwe. Sebenzisa i-BMP uma uhlelo oluyamukelayo ludinga isihloko sefayela le-BMP.
Igcina i-PNG engalahli idatha njengombhalo we-Base64, oqala ngokuthi data:image/png;base64,. Vula leli fayela lombhalo futhi ukuze ubuyise isithombe. I-Base64 inkulu kune-PNG ekuyo.

Thepha Sebenzisa isithombe ukuze usifake ngokushesha. Kopisha imininingwane yomthombo eduze kwesithombe kukopisha isihloko, umshicileli, umthombo nelayisense ukuze usebenzise kokushicilelayo. Umsebenzi wokuqala we-Catrobat uyi-CC BY-SA 4.0; gcina noma yibaphi abadali ababalulwe ngokwehlukile, amalungelo obunikazi nezinye izaziso zomthombo. Chaza izinguquko zakho futhi wabelane ngemisebenzi eguquliwe ngaphansi kwe-CC BY-SA 4.0 noma ilayisense ehambisanayo. Hlela imininingwane yemithombo kukuvumela ukwengeza le mininingwane; imithombo efakiwe ihlala ngaphansi kokuthi Ifayela → Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga → Imininingwane yemithombo yezithombe.

Ngaphambi kokushicilela, gcina noma yimiphi imininingwane yomdali noma izaziso zamalungelo obunikazi ezibaluliwe bese wengeza incazelo yezinguquko ozenzile. Susa imithombo engekho esithombeni esishicilelwayo. Umbhalo ongezansi uyahleleka.

Ilondoloza isithombe sesithonjana esisodwa esicindezelwe nge-PNG ngosayizi okhethiwe (amaphikseli angu-16–256). Isithombe sakho sigcina izilinganiso zaso futhi sibekwa phakathi kwesikwele esibonisa ngalé.
Ukuqaqa ikhodi yalesi sithonjana kweqa umkhawulo wenkumbulo yezithombe etholakalayo.
Ubukhulu besithombe sesithonjana abuvumelani nohla lwaso.
Khetha usayizi wesithonjana wamaphikseli angu-16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 noma 256.
I-RGB yamabhithi angu-24 engacindezelwe; imibala enembile, amafayela amakhulu.
Le BMP noma GIF isebenzisa iphrofayela yombala i-AN Paint engakakwazi ukuyiguqula. Yiguqulele ku-sRGB PNG kusihleli esilawula imibala ngaphambi kokuyingenisa.
Ipensela ligcina imiphetho icacile kunoma yibuphi ububanzi obukhethiwe.

Vula ikhasi lomsebenzi bese uthepha Sebenzisa isithombe. Sesha ngesiNgisi noma ngesiJapane; izihloko zemisebenzi nombhalo wesayithi kuhlala kusesiJapane. Ukusebenzisa mahhala kungaphansi kwemigomo ye-Irasutoya: imiklamo yezohwebo esebenzisa izinto ezingu-21 noma ngaphezulu idinga inkokhelo. Ukusebenzisana okukhethekile kungaba nemibandela ehlukile. Amakhasi omthombo nemininingwane yabadali kugcinwa ngaphansi kokuthi Ifayela → Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga → Imininingwane yemithombo yezithombe.

Vula ikhasi lomsebenzi bese uthepha Sebenzisa isithombe eduze kokulanda kwalo i-Large PNG. I-Openclipart ishicilela imisebenzi ngaphansi kwe-CC0. Ikhasi lomthombo nelayisense kugcinwa ngaphansi kokuthi Ifayela → Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga → Imininingwane yemithombo yezithombe.
Lesi sithombe singaphandle komthombo wemifanekiso okhethiwe.

Amalungelo obunikazi agcinwa ngumdali. Ukusebenzisa kungaphansi kwemigomo ye-Irasutoya; lena akuyona ilayisense ye-Creative Commons.

Le mininingwane yemithombo yalondolozwa ngaphambili futhi ingase ibe eyezinye izithombe. Khetha umthombo ukuze wengeze imininingwane yawo kulesi sithombe, noma ulondoloze umbhalo wawo ophelele njengefayela.

Lesi sithombe sesivele sinemininingwane yalowo mthombo. Umbhalo wayo ugciniwe.

Setha ikhona eliphezulu kwesokunxele lalesi sithombe endaweni yokudweba yesithombe esizokhishwa. U-X no-Y bangamaphikseli aphelele, baqala kuziro. Ezinye izithombe zigcina izindawo zazo zamanje. Ukwembelana kuvunyelwe lapha; izithombe ezingeniswe kamuva zidwetshwa ngaphezulu. Indawo yokudweba iyanwebeka ukuze ihlanganise zonke izithombe ezibekiwe. Ukunquma nosayizi akushintshi.
U-X no-Y kufanele babe izinombolo eziphelele kusukela kuziro kuye ku-2147483647.

Engeza izithombe ezifika ku-20 ngesikhethi samafayela se-Android. Ithileyi elingezansi libonisa izithonjana, amagama amafayela, ubukhulu bezithombe ngemva kokunquma nanoma yikuphi ukulungiswa kokuthi Ububanzi obufanayo noma Ukuphakama okufanayo, kanye nezikhathi zokushintshwa kwamafayela uma zihlinzekwe umhlinzeki. Hlela ngegama lefayela noma ngesikhathi sokushintshwa; ukuhlela akushintshi ukuhlelwa kwezithombe ezibekiwe.

Thepha isithonjana ukuze usikhethe. Nquma isithombe kunquma leso sithombe; Nquma eziningi kusebenzisa imiphetho yamaphikseli noma yamaphesenti ezithombeni ezikhethiwe. Hudula izibambo zokunquma noma ubhale amanani. Buyisela ukunquma ekuqaleni kubuyisela imiphetho yasekuqaleni. Ukunquma akulimazi okwangempela futhi kungahlehliswa.

Bamba isithonjana, noma uhudule isithombe esisendaweni yokusebenza, bese usidedela emaphethelweni agqanyisiwe. Ukubuka kuqala okubonisa ngalé kancane kubonisa umphumela onembile wokunamathela. Ukunamathisela kwesokudla kuqondanisa imiphetho ephezulu; ukunamathisela ngezansi kuqondanisa imiphetho yesokunxele. Ungathepha nesithonjana bese uthepha indawo eqondiwe ethi +. Lapho kunamatheliswa, isithombe sokuqala siqala ekuqaleni kwezixhumanisi. Izithombe ezinamathiselwe zinganyakaza lapho isithombe ezinamathiselwe kuso sinqunywa. Ukwembelana kuyenqatshwa lapho kunamatheliswa.

Khetha isithombe bese usebenzisa Indawo enembile ukuze usethe izixhumanisi zekhona laso eliphezulu kwesokunxele, u-X/Y, ngamaphikseli aphelele aqala kuziro. Ezinye izithombe zigcina izindawo zazo, futhi ukwembelana kuvunyelwe.

Ububanzi obufanayo nokuthi Ukuphakama okufanayo kunikeza zonke izithombe ezifakiwe ubukhulu obufanayo ohlangothini olulodwa, kugcinwe isilinganiso sobubanzi nokuphakama sesithombe ngasinye. Khetha amaphikseli, amaphesenti, Okuncane kakhulu noma Okukhulu kakhulu. Buyisela osayizi basekuqaleni kususa ukulinganisa osayizi futhi kugcina ukunquma.

Buyisela ethileyini kubuyisela kuphela isithombe esikhethiwe ethileyini. Ezinye izithombe zihlala zibekiwe; izithombe ezinamathiselwe zinganyakaza ukuze zivale isikhala. Susa kususa kuphela leso sithombe esifakiwe. Hlehlisa/Yenza futhi kubuyisela lezi zinguquko. Hudula isithombe esibekiwe ukuze usihlele kabusha; ukuhudula indawo engenalutho kuhambisa okubukwayo. Sondeza noma uhlukanise iminwe ukuze usondeze noma uhlehlise. «Bonisa konke» kulungisa ukusondeza ukuze kubonise yonke inhlanganisela; akulokothi kushintshe ubukhulu besithombe sokukhipha.

Londoloza i-PNG kulondoloza isithombe esihlanganisiwe ngokuqondile. Hlela ku-Paint kusidlulisela kusihleli esikhulu, kuthathe indawo yesithombe samanje njengoshintsho olungahlehliswa. Uma isithombe sokukhipha seqa umkhawulo wenkumbulo, khetha ikhophi encane yokukhipha uma inikezwa. Uma ngisho nesithombe esincanyana sokukhipha seqa umkhawulo, uhlelo lubonisa isixwayiso senkumbulo esikhundleni sesikhethi sosayizi. Amafayela omthombo okuqala awashintshi. Inhlanganisela yamanje igcinwa kudivayisi futhi ivuleka futhi lapho ubuya.

Le modi isebenzisa imininingwane efanayo ye-Catrobat/AGPL neyabadali bezinsiza eboniswa ephanelini elithi «Ifayela > Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga» kusihleli esikhulu.

Khetha Ukubuka, Dweba, Ifayela, Hlela noma Umbala ukuze ubonise izilawuli zaleyo thebhu. Umcibisholo oseduze kwamathebhu uvala noma ubuyisele iphaneli. Uma isikrini simile ngobude, amathebhu nomugqa wamathuluzi kuhamba ngokuvundlile; skrola ukuze ufinyelele kwezinye izilawuli. Uma isikrini silele ngobubanzi, amathebhu namathuluzi ayinhloko kwehla kwesokunxele. Dweba kuqukethe Umdwebo, Ukukhetha nokuthi Faka. Umdwebo uhlanganisa Ipensela, Ibhulashi, Upende wamanzi ne-Ibhulashi lomoya. Ukukhetha kuhlanganisa ukukhetha okunxande nokukhetha komumo okhululekile. Faka kuhlanganisa imigqa, imimo nombhalo. Thepha isigaba ukuze ukhethe ithuluzi laso elikhunjulwayo futhi ubonise amathuluzi nezilungiselelo zaso ngezansi komugqa uma isikrini simile ngobude, noma kwesokudla sawo uma silele ngobubanzi. Thepha isigaba esikhethiwe futhi ukuze uvale noma uvule amathuluzi nezilungiselelo zaso. Izigaba zikhumbula ithuluzi eligcine ukusetshenziswa kuzo phakathi neseshini. Skrola iphaneli yezinketho ukuze uthole ezinye izilungiselelo. Isihloko siqukethe igama lefayela nezenzo ezisheshayo. Imininingwane yabadali nemigomo: «Ifayela > Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga».

Ithebhu ethi Umbala iqukethe inkomba yombala wangaphambili/wangemuva, Shintshanisa imibala, Okumnyama / okumhlophe nokuthi Okuthuthukile. Thepha ingxenye yangaphambili noma yangemuva yenkomba ukuze uhlele lowo mbala. Iphaneli yemibala evamile nemibala elondoloziwe kungaphansi kwesihloko. Thepha isampula evamile ukuze ukhethe umbala wangaphambili noma uyibambe ukuze ukhethe owangemuva. Amaseli amane ngakwesokudla ekugcineni kwephaneli yemibala evamile agcina imibala esetshenziswe muva nje; thepha ukuze ukhethe owangaphambili noma ubambe ukuze ukhethe owangemuva. Isihleli sombala sinokuthi Iphaneli yemibala, Ikhekheba lezinyosi nokuthi Okuthuthukile. Okuthuthukile kunobubanzi bemibala, isondo, izilawuli ze-RGB, HSV, HSL nezamadijithi ayisithupha e-hex. Imibala eyenziwe ngokwezifiso iqala ngokuthi Okunsomi okukhanyayo #5B67FF, Igolide #FFD700, Isiliva #C0C0C0 ne-Ithusi #B87333. Thepha umbala olondoloziwe ukuze uwusebenzise njengowangaphambili; uwubambe ukuze ukhethe ingemuva, uwuhlele noma uwususe. Engeza umbala noma isikhala esingenalutho semibala elondoloziwe kuvula isihleli ukuze ulondoloze umbala. Idokhumenti enkulu ayibonisi ngalé. Ukulayisha isithombe esibonisa ngalé njengendawo yokudweba kugcwalisa izindawo zaso ezibonisa ngalé ngombala wangemuva wamanje. Isithombe esifakiwe sihlala siyindawo ekhethiwe ehamba ngokuzimela; izindawo zaso ezibonisa ngalé ziveza indawo yokudweba ekhona lapho siqinisekiswa. Okungeniswe ku-Wikimedia Commons kufakwa ingemuva elimhlophe ngaphambi kokufakwa. Amafayela omthombo okuqala awashintshi.

Ukubuka > Zulazula: hudula ngomunwe owodwa ukuze uhambise okubukwayo, sondeza noma uhlukanise iminwe emibili ukuze usondeze noma uhlehlise futhi uhambise okubukwayo. Khetha Buyela ekudwebeni ezinkethweni ze-Zulazula, noma ukhethe ithuluzi lokudweba, ukuze ubuyele ekudwebeni. Ukuzulazula ngeminwe emibili kusebenza nasemathuluzini okudweba ngaphandle kokushiya amamaki opende. Isilayidi esingezansi kwesokudla sinomugqa ophakathi ku-100%. Izinkinobho zokusondeza/zokuhlehlisa zima ku-100% lapho isinyathelo singaweqa; cindezela futhi ukuze uqhubeke. Inkinobho eseduze ethi Lungisa usayizi wokubuka ukuze kulingane yenza indawo yokudweba nanoma iyiphi indawo ekhethiwe ehamba ngokuzimela kulingane futhi kube phakathi kokubuka. Zulazula iphinde inikeze u-100%; Ukubuka kunikeza igridi yamaphikseli.

Ukulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela kugcina umsebenzi ongakaqedwa wamanje ngemva kwekhefu elifushane lokuhlela nalapho uphuma kuhlelo. Isimo sibonisa ukuthi Umsebenzi ongakaqedwa ulondoloziwe noma iphutha lokulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela. Ukuvula futhi kubuyisela umsebenzi ongakaqedwa, igama lefayela, izilungiselelo zamathuluzi, indawo ekhethiwe ehamba ngokuzimela nemimo engakaqedwa. Ukulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela kugcina umsebenzi wangasese ongakaqedwa wokusebenza. Ifayela linikeza i-PNG, i-JPEG ne-HEIC enekhwalithi elungisekayo, kanye ne-JPEG XL, WebP ne-AVIF engalahli noma elahlekelwa idatha. Londoloza njenge kukhetha ifomethi yesithombe, izilungiselelo nendawo; Londoloza kubhala khona futhi. Thekelisa njenge nokuthi Londoloza futhi wabelane kubhala ikhophi ngaphandle kokushintsha indawo yamanje yokulondoloza noma ukumaka umdwebo njengolondoloziwe. Londoloza futhi wabelane kube sekuvula ukwabelana kwe-Android. Inkanyezi egameni lefayela isho ukuthi umdwebo unezinguquko ezingakalondolozwa. Ukulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela akulokothi kubhale phezu kwezithombe zomthombo.

Izindawo ezikhethiwe: dweba unxande noma uhlaka lomumo okhululekile. Hudula ngaphakathi ukuze uhambise, hudula ikhona eliyisikwele noma iphuzu eliphakathi konqenqema ukuze ushintshe usayizi, noma hudula isibambo esiyindilinga sokuzungezisa ukuze uzungezise. Khiya izilinganiso kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo; kucishe ukuze welule ububanzi nokuphakama ngokuzimela. Izibambo zemiphetho zishintsha usayizi ohlangothini olukhethiwe. Izindawo ezikhethiwe zomumo okhululekile zigcina umumo wazo okhethiwe ngaphakathi kwebhokisi lokuguqula, kuhlanganise nangemva kokuzungezisa nokulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela. Ubukhulu ne-engeli kuvela ephanelini yezinketho. Qinisekisa indawo ekhethiwe kusebenzisa umphumela; ukuhlela indawo ekhethiwe kungahlehliswa, futhi ukulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela kugcina ukuguqulwa okungakaqedwa. Kopisha, Sika nokuthi Nquma uye endaweni ekhethiwe kusebenzisa isithombe esiguquliwe. Khetha konke kungaphansi kokuthi Hlela > Ukukhetha, futhi Ctrl+A kusebenza kukhibhodi yangaphandle. Sika, Kopisha nokuthi Namathisela kuyizenzo ezisheshayo esihlokweni. Izifihla-buso zokukhetha zigcina umumo okhethiwe; idokhumenti ngokwayo ihlala ingabonisi ngalé.

Imingcele yendawo yokudweba: hudula izibambo ziye ngaphakathi ukuze unqume noma ngaphandle ukuze wandise kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi, bese ukhetha Sebenzisa imingcele. Indawo entsha isebenzisa umbala wangemuva; usayizi wamaphikseli akhona awushintshwa. Khansela nokuthi Hlehlisa kuyatholakala. Shintsha usayizi wesithombe, Usayizi wendawo yokudweba nokuthi Isithombe esisha nakho kwamukela Amaphikseli noma Amaphesenti ngenketho yokukhiya izilinganiso.

Umugqa ogobile: dweba umugqa bese uhudula kabili ukuze uwugobise. Ipholigoni: thepha amaphuzu amakhona, bese uthepha kabili iphuzu lokugcina noma usebenzise Qedela ipholigoni. Cisha Xhumanisa ichashazi lokugcina nelokuqala ukuze udwebe izingxenye ezixhumene ezivulekile. Unxande onamakhona ayindilinga: setha irediyasi (px) ngesilayidi sayo; umumo ngamunye ukhawulela irediyasi kuhhafu wohlangothi lwawo olufushane. Umbhalo: thepha indawo yokudweba, khetha ifonti eboniswa ngesitayela sayo bese usebenzisa ukubuka kuqala okuvuselelwa bukhoma. Izinketho zihlanganisa usayizi, ukugqamisa, ukutshekisa, ukudwebela, ukudwebela phakathi, ukuqondanisa, izikhala zemigqa nebhokisi lombhalo elinombala wangemuva. Upende wamanzi usesigabeni esithi Umdwebo eduze kwe-Ibhulashi ne-Ibhulashi lomoya; lungisa amandla ukuze uthole imigqa ethambile. Izilayidi zosayizi wepensela, webhulashi nowamathuluzi zifika kumaphikseli angu-100. Ipensela liqala ngephikseli elingu-1 futhi likhumbula ububanzi balo. Thepha inombolo ebonisiwe ukuze ufake inani elinembile. Inhliziyo, Inkanyezi noMcibisholo kunokukhetha okufanayo kohlaka/ukugcwalisa njengeminye imimo. Ukubuka > Ukudweba ngesikhombi kuvula iswishi yako yokuvumela, umumo wesikhombi nezilungiselelo zokukhulisa. Hudula ukuze ubeke isikhombi, thepha inkinobho yokudweba esesikrinini, bese uhambisa okubukwayo ukuze udwebe. Thepha futhi ukuze uyeke ukudweba. Izilungiselelo zebhulashi nemigqa zihlala ngaphansi kokuthi Dweba > Umdwebo. Ukubuka > Ingilazi yokukhulisa kukuvumela ukuvula ukubuka kuqala okukhulisiwe kwesikhombi noma kwephuzu lokudweba futhi ulungise ukukhuliswa kwako. Izilungiselelo zokudweba ziphinde zinikeze ukushelela kwemiphetho (anti-aliasing) nokwenza imigqa ibe bushelelezi. Kufakwe amafonti ayishumi nanye engeziwe; Amalayisense amafonti aqukethe imininingwane yabadali bawo nemigomo ephelele.

Ifayela > Layisha isithombe kushintsha indawo yokudweba ngesikhethi se-Android. «Dweba → Faka → Ezinye izithombe» kunikeza amafayela edivayisi, i-Catrobat, i-Irasutoya, i-Openclipart nokuthi “Wikimedia Commons · Amamephu angenalutho…”. Khetha isithombe sedivayisi, noma uvule ikhasi lomsebenzi eku-inthanethi bese uthepha «Sebenzisa isithombe», ukuze ufake isithombe njengendawo ekhethiwe ehamba ngokuzimela. Ifayela > Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga > Imininingwane yemithombo yezithombe kugcina izixhumanisi zomthombo nesaziso selayisense. Izithombe ezingaphakathi komkhawulo wenkumbulo wedivayisi zilayishwa ngokucaca kwazo kwasekuqaleni. Uma kudingeka, ibhokisi lokukhetha ukushintsha usayizi libonisa ubukhulu, inani lamaphikseli nezilinganiso zenkumbulo, ngokusetha usayizi ngamaphikseli/ngamaphesenti nenketho yokukhiya izilinganiso. Ifayela lokuqala alishintshi.

«Ifayela» > Ukuhlanganisa izithombe kuvula indawo yokusebenza ehlukile yezithombe ezifika ku-20. Hlela izithonjana ngegama lefayela noma ngesikhathi. Nquma isithombe esisodwa noma eziningi ndawonye. Ububanzi obufanayo / Ukuphakama okufanayo kulinganisa zonke izithombe ezilayishiwe kugcinwe izilinganiso zobubanzi nokuphakama. Hudula izithonjana noma izithombe ezibekiwe ukuze zinamathele kwesokudla kuqondaniswe phezulu noma ngezansi kuqondaniswe kwesokunxele. Indawo enembile isetha ikhona eliphezulu kwesokunxele ngamaphikseli aphelele aqala kuziro, igcina ezinye izithombe ezindaweni zazo futhi ivumela ukwembelana. Izithombe ezingeniswe kamuva zidwetshwa ngaphezulu. Buyisela ethileyini kususa kuphela ukubekwa kwesithombe esikhethiwe. Ezinye izithombe zihlala zibekiwe; izithombe ezinamathiselwe zinganyakaza ukuze zivale isikhala. «Bonisa konke» kulungisa ukusondeza kokubuka. Londoloza i-PNG kuthekelisa inhlanganisela; Hlela ku-Paint kuyidlulisela njengoshintsho olungahlehliswa. Uhlelo lusebenzisa isihleli esisodwa sezithombe ezingabonisi ngalé. Ukuhlanganisa izithombe kuyindawo ehlukile yokuhlela ukubekwa kwazo.

Iphaneli ethi «Ifayela > Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga» iqukethe amalungelo obunikazi okuqala, imininingwane yabadali bezinsiza/amafonti, umbhalo ophelele welayisense nomthombo ophelele wale nguqulo. Umbhalo welayisense uskrola ngokuzimela ezinkinobheni ezimile ezithi Kopisha konke, Eminye imigomo nokuthi Kwenziwe.

Khetha ithebhu ukuze ubonise izilawuli zayo. Ukubuka kuqala ngokuthi Zulazula; Dweba kuqukethe Umdwebo, Ukukhetha nokuthi Faka. Zulazula kuhambisa okubukwayo ngaphandle kokudweba; sondeza noma uhlukanise iminwe emibili ukuze usondeze noma uhlehlise. Umcibisholo oseduze kwamathebhu uvala iphaneli. Wonke amathuluzi anamalebula. Hlela kushintsha indawo ekhethiwe, imingcele yendawo yokudweba, ubukhulu noma isithombe. Umbala ukhetha imibala yangaphambili neyangemuva; Shintshanisa imibala kuyayishintshanisa futhi Okumnyama / okumhlophe kuyibuyisela ekuqaleni. Isikhethi sombala sibonisa ukukhetha kwakho ngokushesha. Sebenzisa umbala kuyakuqinisekisa; Khansela kubuyisela umbala odlule. Engeza umbala noma uthephe isikhala esingenalutho semibala elondoloziwe ukuze ukhethe futhi ulondoloze umbala. Bamba umbala olondoloziwe ukuze uwuhlele noma uwususe. Okuthuthukile kuvula isihleli esinemininingwane eduze kokuthi Okumnyama / okumhlophe. Igridi yamaphikseli ibonisa namarula amaphikseli esithombe; ukudweba ngesikhombi kubonisa u-x/y wamanje eduze kokusondeza. Londoloza njenge kukhetha ifomethi yesithombe, izilungiselelo zokucindezela nendawo; Londoloza kubhala khona futhi kusetshenziswa lezo zilungiselelo. Thekelisa njenge kudala i-ICO, ubuciko be-ASCII noma umbhalo we-Base64 ngaphandle kokumaka umdwebo njengolondoloziwe. Londoloza futhi wabelane kulondoloza ikhophi, bese kuvula ukwabelana kwe-Android. Kugcina indawo yakho yamanje yokulondoloza. Dweba > Faka > Ezinye izithombe kuqukethe amafayela edivayisi, i-Catrobat, i-Irasutoya, i-Openclipart nokuthi “Wikimedia Commons · Amamephu angenalutho…”. Izithombe ezifakiwe zihlala zikhethiwe; ukubuka kubonisa izibambo zazo ngisho nangaphandle kwendawo yokudweba. Lungisa usayizi wesithombe ukuze silingane endaweni yokudweba kushintsha ukubekwa; Usayizi wasekuqaleni kubuyisela ubukhulu bomthombo. Ukulondoloza ngokuzenzakalela kubuyisela umsebenzi ongakaqedwa kanye nazo zombili izinhla zokuhlehlisa nokwenza futhi lapho uvula uhlelo futhi. Ifayela liqukethe nokuhlanganisa izithombe, indlela yokusebenzisa nokuthi Mayelana, amalayisensi nokubonga. Ukufaka umbhalo kusekela ukubhala ngokuvundlile nangokuqondile.
